document.abstract: Some companies and organizations slow down for the summer, but SMPTE goes into high-gear, working on upcoming events that start in September, and go right through to February. Always endeavoring to deliver top-notch seminars, panels, and educational sessions, we live up to one of SMPTE's own standards: to bring you the information you need to stay ahead, in times when technology seems to change daily.
